scripted_findings.title: 1 page(s) suppress text snippets
scripted_findings.evidence: 1/12 pages carry nosnippet or max-snippet:0, or wrap their primary content in data-nosnippet. Examples: ['https://www.framer.com/education/students']. These pages stay indexed but their text may not be quoted in an AI answer -- the page can pass every other check and still be unquotable.

scripted_findings.title: Form field(s) without a label in a template used on 3 page(s)
scripted_findings.evidence: Form action='(none)' (fields: Prompt, comments, company, description, details, feedback, message, notes, remarks, subject, title, website) appears on 3 page(s); 12 of 12 field(s) have no associated label: Prompt (unlabelled, required), website (unlabelled), company (unlabelled), message (unlabelled), subject (unlabelled), title (unlabelled). Placeholder text disappears once typing starts, so a required field with nothing else naming it is easy to get wrong.

scripted_findings.title: Interactive controls without an accessible name on 2 page(s)
scripted_findings.evidence: https://www.framer.com/: 7/432 controls expose no text, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, SVG title or image alt; https://www.framer.com/agents: 11/575 controls expose no text, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, SVG title or image alt. Controls whose name is bound by a JS framework (v-, x-, ng-, :, @, [) were assumed named at runtime and not counted.

scripted_findings.title: No Product structured data on 1 product page(s)
scripted_findings.evidence: 1/12 crawled product pages carry no Product JSON-LD, so the price, availability and identity of the item are stated only in prose, if at all. Examples: ['https://www.framer.com/store/faq']. Structured data is read by the indexing crawlers that build the search index assistants query.

scripted_findings.title: Questions are not paired with self-contained answers on 6 page(s)
scripted_findings.evidence: https://www.framer.com/pricing asks 11 questions in its own headings, e.g. ['What are credits?', 'What’s included in the Free plan?', 'Which plan is right for me?'], but nothing on the page pairs each question with a self-contained answer: no FAQPage or Question structured data. An assistant lifting an answer takes the question plus the answer as one unit, and here it has to guess where each answer ends.
